# The Trivy scanner image the scan-images job in .github/workflows/ci.yml runs, pinned by tag and digest.
# Docker verifies the digest; the tag is kept beside it for readability.
#
# It lives here rather than in the workflow because nothing would watch it there: Dependabot reads Dockerfile FROM
# lines and workflow `uses:` references, not an image named in a job's env, and the jim-automation App that commits
# tooling-pin-check's bumps has no permission to write .github/workflows/. tooling-pin-check
# (.github/scripts/check-tooling-pins.ps1) watches this file weekly and raises a PR moving tag and digest together.
# The one line that is not a comment is the image reference.
aquasec/trivy:0.76.0@sha256:2416d1f74045b57274df1a340eee6b510cacd73c66a6ccb8da092b117eb7d222
